    // One request is capped by PostgREST \"max rows\" (Supabase default 1000), so a·
    // month for ~250 employees used to come back as only the newest ~4 days·
    // (the RPC orders work_date DESC). We fetch the range in small date windows and·
    // page inside each window until a short page arrives. PAGE_SIZE must stay at or·
    // below the project's max-rows setting.·
    const PAGE_SIZE = 500;·
    // One day per request. The server builds the WHOLE window for every page it·
    // returns (LIMIT/OFFSET are applied after the function), so a 3-day window·
    // that needed 2 pages was computed twice. One-day windows fit in one page.·
    const WINDOW_DAYS = 1;·
    const WINDOW_CONCURRENCY = 4;·
    // Same day requested by several screens / every live refresh: reuse it briefly.·
    const DAY_CACHE_MS = 30_000;·
    const dayCache = new Map<string, { at: number; rows: Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> }>();···
    class CanonicalRpcMissingError extends Error {}···
    function dateWindows(start: string, end: string): Array<[string, string]> {·
      // Newest window first, matching the RPC's work_date DESC order.·
      const windows: Array<[string, string]> = [];·
      let windowEnd = end;·
      while (windowEnd >= start) {·
        const candidate = addBusinessDays(windowEnd, -(WINDOW_DAYS - 1));·
        const windowStart = candidate < start ? start : candidate;·
        windows.push([windowStart, windowEnd]);·
        windowEnd = addBusinessDays(windowStart, -1);·
      }·
      return windows;·
    }···
    const istClock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(\"en-GB\", {·
      timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
      hour: \"2-digit\",·
      minute: \"2-digit\",·
      second: \"2-digit\",·
      hourCycle: \"h23\",·
    });···
    /**·
     * Late = first check-in (IST) at or after the office policy time·
     * (late_checkin_time from the server, 10:33:00 if no policy). The canonical·
     * RPC has no is_late column, so this is the single place it is derived.·
     */·
    export function isLateCheckin(firstIn: string | null | undefined, lateTime: string | null | undefined): boolean {·
      if (!firstIn) return false;·
      const instant = new Date(firstIn);·
      if (Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())) return false;·
      const threshold = String(lateTime || DEFAULT_LATE_CHECKIN_TIME);·
      const normalized = threshold.length === 5 ? `${threshold}:00` : threshold.slice(0, 8);·
      return istClock.format(instant) >= normalized;·
    }···
    export function mapRow(c: any): CanonicalAttendanceDay {·
      return {·
        ...c,·
        official_first_in: c.effective_checkin,·
        official_last_out: c.effective_checkout,·
        attendance_status: c.effective_status,·
        is_late: c.is_late ?? isLateCheckin(c.effective_checkin ?? c.official_first_in, c.late_checkin_time),·
        check_in_office_id: c.check_in_office_id ?? c.office_id,·
        check_in_office_name: c.check_in_office_name ?? c.office_name,·
        attendance_source:·
          c.attendance_source ?? (c.biometric_first_in ? \"BIOMETRIC\" : \"APP\"),·
        first_in_source:·
          c.app_first_in && c.biometric_first_in·
            ? \"COMBINED\"·
            : c.biometric_first_in·
              ? \"BIOMETRIC\"·
              : c.app_first_in·
                ? \"APP\"·
                : c.field_visit_first_in·
                  ? \"FIELD_VISIT\"·
                  : \"NONE\",·
      } as CanonicalAttendanceDay;·
    }···
    export const CanonicalAttendanceService = {·
      /**·
       * Fetch every row for the date range. Never returns a silently truncated·
       * result: throws if more than `maximum` rows would be loaded.·
       * Authorization is enforced by the RPC; scopeFilters can only narrow it.·
       */·
      async list(·
        start: string,·
        end: string,·
        maximum = 20_000,·
        scopeFilters?: any,·
      ): Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> {·
        if (end < start) return [];·
        const windows = dateWindows(start, end);·
        const results: CanonicalAttendanceDay[][] = new Array(windows.length);·
        let loaded = 0;···
        try {·
          for (let i = 0; i < windows.length; i += WINDOW_CONCURRENCY) {·
            const batch = windows.slice(i, i + WINDOW_CONCURRENCY);·
            const pages = await Promise.all(·
              batch.map(([ws, we]) => this._listWindow(ws, we, scopeFilters)),·
            );·
            pages.forEach((rows, j) => {·
              results[i + j] = rows;·
              loaded += rows.length;·
            });·
            if (loaded > maximum) {·
              throw new Error(·
                \"Range too large: narrow the date range or office filter to load attendance data.\",·
              );·
            }·
          }·
        } catch (error) {·
          if (error instanceof CanonicalRpcMissingError) {·
            return this._listFromView(start, end, maximum, scopeFilters);·
          }·
          throw error;·
        }···
        return results.flat();·
      },···
      /** One date window from the RPC, paged until a short page. */·
      async _listWindow(·
        start: string,·
        end: string,·
        scopeFilters?: any,·
      ): Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> {·
        const rows: CanonicalAttendanceDay[] = [];·
        for (let offset = 0; ; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {·
          const { data, error } = await supabase·
            .rpc(\"rpc_attendance_canonical_range\", {·
              p_start_date: start,·
              p_end_date: end,·
              p_office_id: scopeFilters?.office_id ?? null,·
              p_team_id: scopeFilters?.team_id ?? null,·
              p_user_id: scopeFilters?.user_id ?? null,·
            })·
            .range(offset, offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1);···
          if (error) {·
            if (error.code === \"PGRST202\" || error.code === \"42883\") {·
              throw new CanonicalRpcMissingError(error.message);·
            }·
            if (error.code === \"57014\" || error.message?.includes(\"timeout\")) {·
              throw new Error(·
                \"The date range is too large. Please select a shorter date range to prevent timeouts.\",·
              );·
            }·
            throw new Error(error.message);·
          }···
          const page = (data ?? []).map(mapRow);·
          rows.push(...page);·
          if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) return rows;·
        }·
      },···
      /** Fallback: paginate directly against the canonical view. */·
      async _listFromView(·
        start: string,·
        end: string,·
        maximum: number,·
        scopeFilters?: any,·
      ): Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> {·
        const rows: CanonicalAttendanceDay[] = [];·
        for (let offset = 0; offset <= maximum; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {·
          const { data, error } = await supabase·
            .from(\"v_attendance_daily_canonical\")·
            .select(\"*\")·
            .gte(\"work_date\", start)·
            .lte(\"work_date\", end)·
            .match(scopeFilters || {})·
            .order(\"work_date\", { ascending: false })·
            .order(\"employee_name\", { ascending: true })·
            .order(\"user_id\", { ascending: true })·
            .range(offset, offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1);···
          if (error) {·
            if (error.code === \"57014\" || error.message?.includes(\"timeout\")) {·
              throw new Error(·
                \"The date range is too large. Please select a shorter date range.\",·
              );·
            }·
            throw new Error(error.message);·
          }···
          const page = (data ?? []).map(mapRow);·
          rows.push(...page);·
          if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) return rows;·
        }·
        throw new Error(·
          \"Range too large: narrow the date range or office filter to load attendance data.\",·
        );·
      },···
      /**·
       * One business day. Calls made within 30 s of each other (Live Tracking·
       * refreshes, dashboards) share one server request instead of each running·
       * the expensive attendance calculation again.·
       */·
      async listDay(workDate: string, options?: { fresh?: boolean }) {·
        const cached = dayCache.get(workDate);·
        if (!options?.fresh && cached && Date.now() - cached.at < DAY_CACHE_MS) {·
          return cached.rows;·
        }·
        const rows = this.list(workDate, workDate, 5_000);·
        dayCache.set(workDate, { at: Date.now(), rows });·
        rows.catch(() => {·
          if (dayCache.get(workDate)?.rows === rows) dayCache.delete(workDate);·
        });·
        return rows;·
      },···
      /** Forget cached days (after an attendance correction or a manual refresh). */·
      invalidateDayCache() {·
        dayCache.clear();·
      },·
    };···
    /** Compatibility projection while older cards are migrated to v3 field names. */·
    export function withAttendanceV2Aliases(row: CanonicalAttendanceDay) {·

        date: row.work_date,·

      };·
    }·

        if (status.includes(\"NO CHECKOUT\") || status.includes(\"P-NC\")) {·

        if (status.includes(\"CONFIG REQUIRED\")) {·

        return { background: theme.infoBg, foreground: theme.infoText };·

        window.alert(message ? `${title}\\n\\n${message}` : title);·
      } else {·
        Alert.alert(title, message);·
      }·
    }···

    function formatUpdatedAge(loadedAt: number | null): string {·
      if (loadedAt == null) return \"Updating…\";·
      const minutes = Math.floor(Math.max(0, Date.now() - loadedAt) / 60_000);·
      if (minutes < 1) return \"Updated just now\";·
      if (minutes <= 60) return `Updated ${minutes} min ago`;·
      return `Updated at ${new Date(loadedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {·
        hour: \"2-digit\",·
        minute: \"2-digit\",·
        timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
      })}`;·
    }·

    // ─── StatCard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────·
    function StatCard({·
      icon,·
      title,·
      value,·
      subtitle,·
      color,·
      valueColor,·
      onPress,·
    }: {·
      icon: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;·
      title: string;·
      value: string | number;·
      subtitle?: string;·
      color: string;·
      valueColor?: string;·
      onPress?: () => void;·
    }) {·
      const { theme, isDark } = useTheme();·
      return (·
        <Pressable·
          style={({ pressed }) => [·
            styles.statCard,·
            {·
              borderLeftColor: color,·
              backgroundColor: theme.backgroundDefault,·
              opacity: pressed ? 0.88 : 1,·
            },·
            {·
              borderLeftColor: color,·
              backgroundColor: isDark·
                ? \"rgba(255,255,255,0.06)\"·
                : theme.backgroundDefault,·
              opacity: pressed ? 0.88 : 1,·
            },·
            isWeb && styles.statCardWeb,·
          ]}·
          onPress={onPress}·
        >·
          <View style={[styles.statIcon, { backgroundColor: color + \"18\" }]}>·
            <Feather name={icon} size={18} color={color} />·
          </View>·
          <ThemedText·
            type=\"caption\"·
            style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, marginBottom: 2, fontSize: 11 }}·
          >·
            {title}·
          </ThemedText>·
          <ThemedText·
            style={{·
              color: valueColor ?? theme.text,·
              fontWeight: \"800\",·
              fontSize: 20,·
              lineHeight: 26,·
            }}·
          >·
            {value}·
          </ThemedText>·
          {subtitle ? (·
            <ThemedText·
              type=\"caption\"·
              style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, fontSize: 10, marginTop: 1 }}·
            >·
              {subtitle}·
            </ThemedText>·
          ) : null}·
        </Pressable>·
      );·
    }···

      const recordFraudEvidence = async (·
        attendanceId: string | undefined,·

      const handleUndoCheckout = async () => {·

          });·

      const handleCheckOut = async () => {·

            );·

        } finally {·

        }·
      };···
      const handleAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        // Set before any await so a double tap cannot start two check-ins.·
        if (attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current) return;·
        attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = true;·
        try {·
          await runAttendanceToggle();·
        } finally {·
          attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = false;·
        }·
      };···
      const runAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) {·
          showAlert(\"Error\", \"You must be logged in.\");·
          return;·
        }·
        if (!(await attendanceInternetAvailable())) {·
          await runOfflineAttendance();·
          return;·
        }···
        if (isCheckedIn && isCheckedOut) {·
          showAlert(·
            \"Attendance Complete\",·
            \"You have already checked in and out for today.\",·
          );·

        }···
        if (isCheckedIn) {·
          await handleCheckOut();·
          return;·
        }···
        setAttendanceLoading(true);·

            office: verifiedCheckIn.office,·

                  longitude: gps.longitude,·

                  failure_reason: null,·
                },·
              },·
            );·
            if (auditError) {·
              console.warn(\"Check-in succeeded but audit logging failed\");·
            }·
          } catch {·
            console.warn(\"Check-in succeeded but audit logging was unavailable\");·
          }···
          if (!checkInResult.side_effects_committed) {·
            throw new Error(·

      const handleEventAttendance = async (event: EventAttendanceAction) => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·

      const { theme, isDark } = useTheme();·
      const { user } = useAuth();·
      const isFocused = useIsFocused();·
      const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();·
      const { health: trackingHealth, recheck: recheckTracking } =·
        useLocationTracking();·······
      const [todayAttendance, setTodayAttendance] = useState<any>(null);·
      const [pendingTasks, setPendingTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);·
      const [dashboardLoadError, setDashboardLoadError] = useState<string | null>(·
        null,·
      );·
      const [serverBusinessHour, setServerBusinessHour] = useState<number | null>(·
        null,·
      );·
      const [leaveBalance, setLeaveBalance] = useState({·
        sick: 0,·
        casual: 0,·
        earned: 0,·
        comp_off: 0,·
      });·
      const [unreadNotifications, setUnreadNotifications] = useState(0);·
      const [attendanceLoading, setAttendanceLoading] = useState(false);·
      const [showAttendanceCheckout, setShowAttendanceCheckout] = useState(false);·
      const [pendingVisits, setPendingVisits] = useState(0);·
      const [geofenceEvent, setGeofenceEvent] = useState<{ id: string; distance: number } | null>(null);·
      const [checkInMsg, setCheckInMsg] = useState<{·
        type: \"success\" | \"error\";·
        text: string;·
      } | null>(null);·
      const [userBaseLat, setUserBaseLat] = useState<number | null>(null);·
      const [userBaseLng, setUserBaseLng] = useState<number | null>(null);·
      const [isEscalationMember, setIsEscalationMember] = useState(false);·
      const [upcomingEvents, setUpcomingEvents] = useState<EventAttendanceAction[]>(·
        [],·
      );·
      const [eventAnnouncements, setEventAnnouncements] = useState<·
        EventAnnouncement[]·
      >([]);·
      const [acknowledgingEventId, setAcknowledgingEventId] = useState<·
        string | null·
      >(null);·
      const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);·
      const [showEventPicker, setShowEventPicker] = useState(false);·
      const [eventCheckInLoading, setEventCheckInLoading] = useState(false);·
      const [showReminderModal, setShowReminderModal] = useState<{·
        type: \"checkin\" | \"checkout\";·
      } | null>(null);·
      const [hasTeam, setHasTeam] = useState(false);·
      const [undoCheckout, setUndoCheckout] = useState<{·
        attendanceId: string;·
        token: string;·
        expiresAt: string;·
      } | null>(null);·
      const [undoSeconds, setUndoSeconds] = useState(0);·
      const dashboardRequestRef = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null);·
      const eventRequestRef = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null);·
      const eventsGenerationRef = useRef(0);·
      const [eventsLoadError, setEventsLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);·
      const [lastLoadedAt, setLastLoadedAt] = useState<number | null>(null);·
      const [, setUpdatedTick] = useState(0);·
      const [staleSession, setStaleSession] = useState<{·
        id: string;·
        date: string;·
      } | null>(null);·
      const attendanceToggleInFlightRef = useRef(false);·
      // Attendance saved on this phone while offline, not yet confirmed by the server.·
      const [offlineCheckInAt, setOfflineCheckInAt] = useState<string | null>(null);·
      const [offlineCheckOutPending, setOfflineCheckOutPending] = useState(false);·
      const offlinePendingCountRef = useRef(0);···
      const isCheckedIn = !!(·
        todayAttendance?.checkin_time ||·
        todayAttendance?.checkIn ||·
        todayAttendance?.check_in·
      );·
      const isCheckedOut = !!(·
        todayAttendance?.checkout_time ||·
        todayAttendance?.checkOut ||·
        todayAttendance?.check_out·
      );···
      useEffect(() => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·
        secureStorage.getItem(`undo_checkout_${user.id}`).then((raw) => {·
          if (!raw) return;·
          try {·
            const saved = JSON.parse(raw);·
            if (·
              saved.attendanceId &&·
              saved.token &&·
              Date.parse(saved.expiresAt) > Date.now()·
            ) {·
              setUndoCheckout(saved);·
            } else {·
              secureStorage.removeItem(`undo_checkout_${user.id}`);·
            }·
          } catch {·
            secureStorage.removeItem(`undo_checkout_${user.id}`);·
          }·
        });·
      }, [user?.id]);···
      useEffect(() => {·
        if (!undoCheckout || !user?.id) {·
          setUndoSeconds(0);·
          return;·
        }·
        const update = () => {·
          const seconds = Math.max(·
            0,·
            Math.ceil((Date.parse(undoCheckout.expiresAt) - Date.now()) / 1000),·
          );·
          setUndoSeconds(seconds);·
          if (seconds === 0) {·
            setUndoCheckout(null);·
            secureStorage.removeItem(`undo_checkout_${user.id}`);·
          }·
        };·
        update();·
        const timer = setInterval(update, 1000);·
        return () => clearInterval(timer);·
      }, [undoCheckout, user?.id]);···
      // ── data loader ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────·
      const loadData = useCallback(·
        (force = false): Promise<void> => {·
          if (!user?.id) return Promise.resolve();·
          if (dashboardRequestRef.current) {·
            // A manual refresh must not be satisfied by a load that started·
            // before it (possibly from cache): wait for it, then load fresh.·
            if (!force) return dashboardRequestRef.current;·
            const pending = dashboardRequestRef.current;·
            return pending.then(() => {·
              if (dashboardRequestRef.current) return dashboardRequestRef.current;·
              DashboardSummaryService.invalidateEmployee(user.id);·
              return loadDataRef.current(true);·
            });·
          }···
          const request = (async () => {·
            try {·
              const summary = await DashboardSummaryService.getEmployee(·
                user.id,·
                force,·
              );·
              setServerBusinessHour(·
                Number(·
                  new Intl.DateTimeFormat(\"en-US\", {·
                    timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
                    hour: \"2-digit\",·
                    hourCycle: \"h23\",·
                  }).format(new Date(summary.server_now)),·
                ),·
              );·
              setTodayAttendance(summary.attendance ?? null);·
              setUserBaseLat(summary.base_latitude ?? null);·
              setUserBaseLng(summary.base_longitude ?? null);·
              setLeaveBalance({·
                sick: Number(summary.leave_balance?.sick) || 0,·
                casual: Number(summary.leave_balance?.casual) || 0,·
                earned: Number(summary.leave_balance?.earned) || 0,·
                comp_off: Number(summary.leave_balance?.comp_off) || 0,·
              });·
              setPendingTasks(summary.pending_tasks);·
              setUnreadNotifications(Number(summary.unread_notifications) || 0);·
              setPendingVisits(Number(summary.pending_visits) || 0);·
              setIsEscalationMember(summary.is_escalation_member === true);···
              const privilegedRole = [·
                \"SYSTEM_ADMIN\",·
                \"ADMIN\",·
                \"HR\",·
                \"HRD\",·
              ].includes(user.role);·
              setHasTeam(·
                !privilegedRole && Number(summary.direct_reports || 0) > 0,·
              );·
              setDashboardLoadError(null);·
              const serverNow = summary.server_now·
                ? Date.parse(summary.server_now)·
                : NaN;·
              setLastLoadedAt(Number.isFinite(serverNow) ? serverNow : Date.now());···
              if (!summary.attendance) {·
                AttendanceService.getStalePreviousDaySession(user.id)·
                  .then((stale) =>·
                    setStaleSession(·
                      stale ? { id: stale.id, date: stale.date } : null,·
                    ),·
                  )·
                  .catch(() => undefined);·
              } else {·
                setStaleSession(null);·
              }···
              if (!eventRequestRef.current || force) {·
                // Only the latest events request may set state.·
                const generation = ++eventsGenerationRef.current;·
                const eventRequest = Promise.all([·
                  EventService.getEventsAvailableForAttendance(user.id),·
                  EventService.getAnnouncements(user.id),·
                ])·
                  .then(([events, announcements]) => {·
                    if (generation !== eventsGenerationRef.current) return;·
                    setUpcomingEvents(events);·
                    setEventAnnouncements(announcements);·
                    setEventsLoadError(null);·
                  })·
                  .catch((eventError: any) => {·
                    if (generation !== eventsGenerationRef.current) return;·
                    setEventsLoadError(·
                      `Events could not be loaded: ${eventError?.message || \"query failed\"}`,·
                    );·
                  })·
                  .finally(() => {·
                    if (eventRequestRef.current === eventRequest) {·
                      eventRequestRef.current = null;·
                    }·
                  });·
                eventRequestRef.current = eventRequest;·
              }·
            } catch (error: any) {·
              setDashboardLoadError(·
                error?.message ||·
                  \"Dashboard data could not be loaded. Previous values are being preserved.\",·
              );·
            }·
          })();···
          dashboardRequestRef.current = request;·
          return request.finally(() => {·
            if (dashboardRequestRef.current === request) {·
              dashboardRequestRef.current = null;·
            }·
          });·
        },·
        [user?.id, user?.role],·
      );·
      const loadDataRef = useRef(loadData);·
      loadDataRef.current = loadData;···
      // The 15 s summary cache must not hide an attendance change just made.·
      const reloadAfterAttendanceChange = useCallback(() => {·
        if (user?.id) DashboardSummaryService.invalidateEmployee(user.id);·
        return loadData(true);·
      }, [user?.id, loadData]);···
      // Offline-saved attendance: show it, and reload from the server once it syncs.·
      useEffect(() => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·
        const refreshOffline = async () => {·
          const pending = await OfflineAttendanceService.pending(user.id);·
          const checkIn = await OfflineAttendanceService.pendingCheckInToday(user.id);·
          setOfflineCheckInAt(checkIn?.payload.location.capturedAt ?? null);·
          setOfflineCheckOutPending(pending.some((item) => item.operationType === \"ATTENDANCE_CHECKOUT\"));·
          if (pending.length < offlinePendingCountRef.current) void reloadAfterAttendanceChange();·
          offlinePendingCountRef.current = pending.length;·
        };·
        void refreshOffline();·
        return DurableWriteOutbox.subscribe(() => void refreshOffline());·
      }, [user?.id, reloadAfterAttendanceChange]);···
      useFocusEffect(·
        useCallback(() => {·
          void loadData();·
          // Returning from Settings / the setup screen re-checks tracking too.·
          void recheckTracking();·
        }, [loadData, recheckTracking]),·
      );···
      // Re-render the \"Updated …\" age every 30 s while focused.·
      useEffect(() => {·
        if (!isFocused) return;·
        const interval = setInterval(() => setUpdatedTick((tick) => tick + 1), 30_000);·
        return () => clearInterval(interval);·
      }, [isFocused]);···
      // Confirmed office exit waiting for this employee's reason (server-detected).·
      const checkPendingGeofenceReason = useCallback(async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·
        const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(\"rpc_my_pending_geofence_reason\");·
        if (error || !data || typeof data !== \"object\" || !(data as any).id) {·
          setGeofenceEvent(null);·
          return;·
        }·
        setGeofenceEvent({ id: String((data as any).id), distance: Number((data as any).distance) || 0 });·
      }, [user?.id]);···
      useFocusEffect(·
        useCallback(() => {·
          void checkPendingGeofenceReason();·
          const timer = setInterval(() => void checkPendingGeofenceReason(), 5 * 60_000);·
          return () => clearInterval(timer);·
        }, [checkPendingGeofenceReason]),·
      );···
      // A biometric punch is imported by the server even when this app is already·
      // open. Realtime refreshes the card immediately; polling is a fallback for·
      // devices or networks where the Realtime socket is suspended.·
      useEffect(() => {·
        if (!user?.id || !isFocused) return;·
        const channel = supabase·
          .channel(`dashboard-attendance-${user.id}`)·
          .on(·
            \"postgres_changes\",·
            {·
              event: \"*\",·
              schema: \"public\",·
              table: \"attendance_logs\",·
              filter: `user_id=eq.${user.id}`,·
            },·
            () => {·
              DashboardSummaryService.invalidateEmployee(user.id);·
              void loadData(true);·
            },·
          )·
          .subscribe();·
        const interval = setInterval(() => void loadData(), 60_000);·
        return () => {·
          clearInterval(interval);·
          supabase.removeChannel(channel);·
        };·
      }, [user?.id, isFocused, loadData]);···
      const { refreshing, onRefresh } = useScreenRefresh(async () => {·
        if (user?.id) DashboardSummaryService.invalidateEmployee(user.id);·
        await Promise.all([loadData(true), recheckTracking()]);·
      });···
      const acknowledgeEvent = async (announcement: EventAnnouncement) => {·
        if (!user?.id || announcement.acknowledgedAt) return;·
        setAcknowledgingEventId(announcement.eventId);·
        try {·
          const acknowledgedAt = await EventService.acknowledgeEvent(·
            announcement.eventId,·
            user.id,·
          );·
          setEventAnnouncements((current) =>·
            current.map((item) =>·
              item.eventId === announcement.eventId·
                ? { ...item, acknowledgedAt }·
                : item,·
            ),·
          );·
          setUnreadNotifications((count) => Math.max(0, count - 1));·
        } catch (error: any) {·
          showAlert(\"Unable to acknowledge\", error?.message || \"Please try again.\");·
        } finally {·
          setAcknowledgingEventId(null);·
        }·
      };···
      const openEventInTasks = (eventId: string) => {·
        navigation.getParent()?.navigate(\"TasksTab\", {·
          screen: \"Tasks\",·
          params: { eventId },·
        });·
      };···
      const getGreeting = () => {·
        const h = serverBusinessHour;·
        if (h == null) return \"Welcome\";·
        if (h < 12) return \"Good Morning\";·
        if (h < 17) return \"Good Afternoon\";·
        return \"Good Evening\";·
      };···
      // ── check-in handler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────·
      const getCurrentLocation = async () => {·
        if (Platform.OS !== \"web\") {·
          const { status } = await Location.getForegroundPermissionsAsync();·
          if (status !== \"granted\") {·
            const requested = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();·
            if (requested.status !== \"granted\") {·
              showAlert(\"Location permission is required for attendance.\");·
              return null;·
            }·
          }·
        }···
        const gps = await getCurrentGPS();·
        if (!gps) {·
          showAlert(\"Location not available\", gpsFailureMessage());·
          return null;·
        }·
        if (gps.mocked) {·
          showAlert(·
            \"Mock location detected\",·
            \"Attendance cannot be marked while a mock-location provider is active.\",·
          );·
          return null;·
        }·
        if (gps.accuracy != null && gps.accuracy > 100) {·
          showAlert(·
            \"GPS accuracy is too low\",·
            `Current accuracy is about ${Math.round(gps.accuracy)} metres. Move outdoors or enable precise location and try again.`,·
          );·
          return null;·
        }···
        return gps;·
      };···
      const recordFraudEvidence = async (·
        attendanceId: string | undefined,·
        eventType: \"CHECKIN\" | \"CHECKOUT\",·
        location: NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getCurrentGPS>>>,·
        officeDistance: number,·
      ) => {·
        if (!user?.id || !attendanceId) return;·
        try {·
          const developerMode = await isDeveloperModeEnabled();·
          await AttendanceFraudService.analyze({·
            userId: user.id,·
            attendanceId,·
            eventType,·
            location: {·
              latitude: location.latitude,·
              longitude: location.longitude,·
              accuracy: location.accuracy ?? null,·
              mocked: location.mocked ?? false,·
              developerMode: developerMode ?? false,·
            },·
            officeDistance,·
          });·
        } catch (error) {·
          console.warn(\"Attendance fraud evidence was not recorded:\", error);·
        }·
      };···
      const handleUndoCheckout = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id || !undoCheckout) return;·
        setAttendanceLoading(true);·
        try {·
          const result = await AttendanceService.undoCheckout({·
            userId: user.id,·
            attendanceId: undoCheckout.attendanceId,·
            undoToken: undoCheckout.token,·
          });·
          if (!result.success)·
            return showAlert(\"Unable to undo checkout\", result.message);·
          setUndoCheckout(null);·
          await secureStorage.removeItem(`undo_checkout_${user.id}`);·
          await reloadAfterAttendanceChange();·
          showAlert(\"Checkout undone\", \"Your attendance session is active again.\");·
        } finally {·
          setAttendanceLoading(false);·
        }·
      };···
      const handleCheckOut = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) {·
          showAlert(\"Error\", \"You must be logged in.\");·
          return;·
        }···
        setAttendanceLoading(true);·
        try {·
          const fresh = await AttendanceService.getToday(user.id);·
          if (!fresh.data?.checkin_time) {·
            showAlert(\"Not Checked In\", \"You need to check in first.\");·
            return;·
          }···
          if (fresh.data?.checkout_time) {·
            showAlert(·
              \"Already Checked Out\",·
              `You already checked out at ${new Date(fresh.data.checkout_time).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\", timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\" })} today.`,·
            );·
            return;·
          }···
          setShowAttendanceCheckout(true);·
        } catch (err: any) {·
          showAlert(·
            \"Unable to check out. Please try again.\",·
            err?.message || undefined,·
          );·
        } finally {·
          setAttendanceLoading(false);·
        }·
      };···
      const runOfflineAttendance = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·
        setAttendanceLoading(true);·
        try {·
          const done = await runOfflineAttendanceAction({·
            userId: user.id,·
            serverCheckedIn: isCheckedIn,·
            serverCheckedOut: isCheckedIn && isCheckedOut,·
            getLocation: getCurrentLocation,·
            alert: showAlert,·
          });·
          if (done === \"CHECKOUT\") setOfflineCheckOutPending(true);·
        } finally {·
          setAttendanceLoading(false);·
        }·
      };···
      const handleAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        // Set before any await so a double tap cannot start two check-ins.·
        if (attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current) return;·
        attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = true;·
        try {·
          await runAttendanceToggle();·
        } finally {·
          attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = false;·
        }·
      };···
      const runAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) {·
          showAlert(\"Error\", \"You must be logged in.\");·
          return;·
        }·
        if (!(await attendanceInternetAvailable())) {·
          await runOfflineAttendance();·
          return;·
        }···
        if (isCheckedIn && isCheckedOut) {·
          showAlert(·
            \"Attendance Complete\",·
            \"You have already checked in and out for today.\",·
          );·
          return;·
        }···
        if (isCheckedIn) {·
          await handleCheckOut();·
          return;·
        }···
        setAttendanceLoading(true);·
        let siteVisitWarning: string | null = null;·
        try {·
          // Re-verify from DB before proceeding — isCheckedIn is derived from local state·
          // which may be stale if the user closed and reopened the app.·
          const fresh = await AttendanceService.getToday(user.id);·
          if (fresh.data?.checkin_time) {·
            setTodayAttendance(fresh.data);·
            setAttendanceLoading(false);·
            showAlert(·
              \"Already Checked In\",·
              `You checked in at ${new Date(fresh.data.checkin_time).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\", timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\" })} today.`,·
            );·
            return;·
          }·
          const gps = await getCurrentLocation();·
          if (!gps) {·
            return;·
          }···
          const verifiedCheckIn = await AttendanceService.officeCheckIn({·
            userId: user.id,·
            location: gps,·
          });·
          const checkInResult = verifiedCheckIn.result;·
          const nearest = {·
            office: verifiedCheckIn.office,·
            distanceMetres: verifiedCheckIn.distanceMetres,·
          };·
          await recordFraudEvidence(·
            checkInResult.id,·
            \"CHECKIN\",·
            gps,·
            nearest.distanceMetres,·
          );·
          try {·
            const { error: auditError } = await supabase.rpc(·
              \"rpc_record_checkin_attempt\",·
              {·
                p_values: {·
                  user_id: user.id,·
                  latitude: gps.latitude,·
                  longitude: gps.longitude,·
                  nearest_office_name: nearest.office.name,·
                  nearest_office_distance_m: nearest.distanceMetres,·
                  status: \"success\",·
                  failure_reason: null,·
                },·
              },·
            );·
            if (auditError) {·
              console.warn(\"Check-in succeeded but audit logging failed\");·
            }·
          } catch {·
            console.warn(\"Check-in succeeded but audit logging was unavailable\");·
          }···
          if (!checkInResult.side_effects_committed) {·
            throw new Error(·
              \"The server did not confirm the transactional check-in side effects.\",·
            );·
          }·
          siteVisitWarning = checkInResult.automatic_site_visit_id·
            ? ` Automatic site visit committed for ${checkInResult.automatic_site_name}.`·
            : null;···
          try {·
            await reloadAfterAttendanceChange();·
          } catch {·
            console.warn(·
              \"Check-in succeeded but the dashboard refresh was deferred\",·
            );·
          }·
          if (Platform.OS !== \"web\") {·
            // Start tracking for the new attendance; open the setup screen only·
            // when something actually needs the employee's attention.·
            void recheckTracking().then((checked) => {·
              if (checked.platformSupported && checked.warning) {·
                navigation.navigate(\"LocationTrackingSetup\");·
              }·
            });·
          }·
          showAlert(·
            \"Checked In ✅\",·
            `Checked in at ${new Date(·
              checkInResult.checkin_time!,·
            ).toLocaleTimeString([], {·
              hour: \"2-digit\",·
              minute: \"2-digit\",·
              timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
            })} · ${nearest.office.name}.${siteVisitWarning ?? \"\"}`,·
          );·
        } catch (e: any) {·
          console.error(\"Check-in error:\", e);·
          try {·
            await supabase.rpc(\"rpc_record_checkin_attempt\", {·
              p_values: {·
                latitude: null,·
                longitude: null,·
                nearest_office_name: null,·
                nearest_office_distance_m: null,·
                status: \"blocked\",·
                failure_reason: e?.message || \"Unknown check-in error\",·
              },·
            });·
          } catch (auditError) {·
            console.warn(·
              \"Failed check-in attempt could not be audited\",·
              auditError,·
            );·
          }·
          showAlert(·
            \"Check-in Failed\",·
            e?.message || \"Check-in failed. Please try again.\",·
          );·
        } finally {·
          setAttendanceLoading(false);·
        }·
      };···
      const handleEventAttendance = async (event: EventAttendanceAction) => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·
        if (event.userCheckInTime && event.userCheckOutTime) {·
          showAlert(·
            \"Event Attendance Completed\",·
            `You have already checked out from \"${event.title}\".`,·
          );·
          return;·
        }·
        const isCheckingOut = !!event.userCheckInTime;·
        setEventCheckInLoading(true);·
        setShowEventPicker(false);·
        try {·
          const gps = await getCurrentGPS();·
          if (!gps) {·
            showAlert(\"Location Required\", gpsFailureMessage());·
            return;·
          }·
          if (isCheckingOut) {·
            const checkoutResult = await EventService.checkOutFromEvent({·
              eventId: event.id,·
              location: gps,·
            });·
            showAlert(·
              \"Event Check-Out ✅\",·
              checkoutResult.alreadyCheckedOut·
                ? `You are already checked out from \"${event.title}\".`·
                : `You have checked out from \"${event.title}\".`,·
            );·
            await reloadAfterAttendanceChange();·
            return;·
          }·
          const result = await EventService.checkInToEvent({·
            eventId: event.id,·
            location: gps,·
          });·
          showAlert(·
            \"Event Check-In ✅\",·
            result.compOffCredited·
              ? `You have checked in to \"${event.title}\". ${result.compOffEligibleDays} comp-off day(s) have been credited.`·
              : result.alreadyCheckedIn·

      if (minutes <= 60) return `Updated ${minutes} min ago`;·
      return `Updated at ${new Date(loadedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {·
        hour: \"2-digit\",·
        minute: \"2-digit\",·
        timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
      })}`;·
    }·

    // ─── StatCard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────·
    function StatCard({·
      icon,·
      title,·
      value,·
      subtitle,·
      color,·
      valueColor,·
      onPress,·
    }: {·
      icon: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;·
      title: string;·
      value: string | number;·
      subtitle?: string;·
      color: string;·
      valueColor?: string;·
      onPress?: () => void;·
    }) {·
      const { theme, isDark } = useTheme();·
      return (·
        <Pressable·
          style={({ pressed }) => [·
            styles.statCard,·
            {·
              borderLeftColor: color,·
              backgroundColor: theme.backgroundDefault,·
              opacity: pressed ? 0.88 : 1,·
            },·
            {·
              borderLeftColor: color,·
              backgroundColor: isDark·
                ? \"rgba(255,255,255,0.06)\"·
                : theme.backgroundDefault,·
              opacity: pressed ? 0.88 : 1,·
            },·
            isWeb && styles.statCardWeb,·
          ]}·
          onPress={onPress}·
        >·
          <View style={[styles.statIcon, { backgroundColor: color + \"18\" }]}>·
            <Feather name={icon} size={18} color={color} />·
          </View>·
          <ThemedText·
            type=\"caption\"·
            style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, marginBottom: 2, fontSize: 11 }}·
          >·
            {title}·
          </ThemedText>·
          <ThemedText·
            style={{·
              color: valueColor ?? theme.text,·
              fontWeight: \"800\",·
              fontSize: 20,·
              lineHeight: 26,·
            }}·
          >·
            {value}·
          </ThemedText>·
          {subtitle ? (·
            <ThemedText·
              type=\"caption\"·
              style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, fontSize: 10, marginTop: 1 }}·
            >·
              {subtitle}·
            </ThemedText>·
          ) : null}·
        </Pressable>·
      );·
    }···
    // ─── QuickAction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────·

      // A biometric punch is imported by the server even when this app is already·

      const { refreshing, onRefresh } = useScreenRefresh(async () => {·

      const acknowledgeEvent = async (announcement: EventAnnouncement) => {·

      const recordFraudEvidence = async (·
        attendanceId: string | undefined,·

      const handleUndoCheckout = async () => {·

          showAlert(\"Error\", \"You must be logged in.\");·
          return;·

      const handleAttendanceToggle = async () => {·

        try {·
          await runAttendanceToggle();·
        } finally {·
          attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = false;·
        }·
      };···
      const runAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) {·
          showAlert(\"Error\", \"You must be logged in.\");·
          return;·
        }·
        if (!(await attendanceInternetAvailable())) {·
          await runOfflineAttendance();·
          return;·
        }···
        if (isCheckedIn && isCheckedOut) {·

            \"Attendance Complete\",·
            \"You have already checked in and out for today.\",·
          );·

        }···
        if (isCheckedIn) {·
          await handleCheckOut();·
          return;·
        }···
        setAttendanceLoading(true);·
        let siteVisitWarning: string | null = null;·
        try {·
          // Re-verify from DB before proceeding — isCheckedIn is derived from local state·
          // which may be stale if the user closed and reopened the app.·
          const fresh = await AttendanceService.getToday(user.id);·
          if (fresh.data?.checkin_time) {·
            setTodayAttendance(fresh.data);·
            setAttendanceLoading(false);·
            showAlert(·
              \"Already Checked In\",·
              `You checked in at ${new Date(fresh.data.checkin_time).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\", timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\" })} today.`,·
            );·
            return;·
          }·
          const gps = await getCurrentLocation();·
          if (!gps) {·
            return;·
          }···
          const verifiedCheckIn = await AttendanceService.officeCheckIn({·
            userId: user.id,·
            location: gps,·
          });·
          const checkInResult = verifiedCheckIn.result;·
          const nearest = {·
            office: verifiedCheckIn.office,·

    }···
    function haversineMetres(·
      lat1: number, lon1: number,·
      lat2: number, lon2: number·
    ): number {·
      const R = 6371000;·
      const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;·
      const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;·
      const a =·
        Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +·
        Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *·
        Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *·
        Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;·
      return Math.round(R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a)));·
    }···
    export const PredefinedSiteService = {·
      async getAll(): Promise<PredefinedSite[]> {·
        const { data, error } = await supabase·
          .from(\"predefined_sites\")·
          .select(\"*\")·
          .eq(\"is_active\", true)·
          .order(\"project_name\", { ascending: true });·
        if (error) { console.error(\"[PredefinedSiteService]\", error); return []; }·
        return data || [];·
      },···
      /** Returns distance in metres from user GPS to the site */·
      distanceTo(·
        site: PredefinedSite,·
        userLat: number,·
        userLon: number·
      ): number {·
        return haversineMetres(site.latitude, site.longitude, userLat, userLon);·
      },···
      /** Returns null if within radius, or an error string if outside */·
      checkGeoFence(·
        site: PredefinedSite,·
        userLat: number,·
        userLon: number·
      ): { allowed: boolean; distanceM: number } {·
        const distanceM = haversineMetres(site.latitude, site.longitude, userLat, userLon);·
        return { allowed: distanceM <= site.checkin_radius_m, distanceM };·
      },···
      /**·
       * Scans all active predefined sites and returns the nearest one·
       * that is within its check-in radius, along with the distance.·
       * Returns null if no site is within range.·
       */·
      async findNearestSiteInRange(·
        userLat: number,·
        userLon: number·
      ): Promise<{ site: PredefinedSite; distanceM: number } | null> {·
        const sites = await this.getAll();·
        let nearest: { site: PredefinedSite; distanceM: number } | null = null;·
        for (const site of sites) {·
          const distanceM = haversineMetres(site.latitude, site.longitude, userLat, userLon);·
          if (distanceM <= site.checkin_radius_m) {·
            if (!nearest || distanceM < nearest.distanceM) {·
              nearest = { site, distanceM };·
            }·
          }·
        }·
        return nearest;·
      },·
    };·

    -- 5. Scope Resolution Helper: can_access_user_data·
    create or replace function public.can_access_user_data(·
      p_target_user_id uuid,·
      p_permission     text·
    )·
    returns boolean·
    language plpgsql·
    stable·
    security definer·
    set search_path = public, pg_temp·
    as $$·
    declare·
      v_uid uuid := auth.uid();·
      v_caller public.profiles%rowtype;·
      v_target public.profiles%rowtype;·
      v_perm record;·
    begin·
      if v_uid is null then·
        return false;·
      end if;···
      -- Admin override·
      select * into v_caller from public.profiles where id = v_uid;·
      if v_caller.role in ('SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'ADMIN') then·
        return true;·
      end if;···
      -- Same user check·
      if p_target_user_id = v_uid then·
        return true;·
      end if;···
      select * into v_target from public.profiles where id = p_target_user_id;···
      -- Check user permissions against target user·
      for v_perm in·
        select permission, scope, scope_id·
        from public.user_permissions·
        where user_id = v_uid and permission = p_permission and revoked_at is null·
      loop·
        if v_perm.scope = 'GLOBAL' then·
          return true;·
        elsif v_perm.scope = 'BRANCH' then·
          if v_perm.scope_id is not null and v_target.office_id = v_perm.scope_id then·
            return true;·
          elsif v_perm.scope_id is null and v_caller.office_id is not null and v_target.office_id = v_caller.office_id then·
            return true;·
          end if;·
        elsif v_perm.scope = 'DEPARTMENT' then·
          if v_target.department is not null and lower(v_target.department) = lower(coalesce(v_caller.department, '')) then·
            return true;·
          end if;·
        elsif v_perm.scope = 'TEAM' then·
          if v_target.reports_to = v_uid or v_target.team = v_caller.team then·
            return true;·
          end if;·
        elsif v_perm.scope = 'SELF' and p_target_user_id = v_uid then·
          return true;·
        end if;·
      end loop;···
      return false;·
    end $$;···
    revoke all on function public.can_access_user_data(uuid, text) from public, anon;·
    grant execute on function public.can_access_user_data(uuid, text) to authenticated;···

    -- Restructured Site Visit Observer Query Architecture·
    -- field_visits -> profiles -> latest location -> visit summary·
    -- Incorporates 4-tier signal status, summary metrics, and scoped access control.···
    create or replace function public.get_site_visit_observer_data(·
      p_date        date,·
      p_employee_id uuid default null,·
      p_visit_id    uuid default null·
    )·
    returns jsonb·
    language plpgsql·
    stable·
    security definer·
    set search_path = public, pg_temp·
    as $$·
    declare·
      v_uid         uuid := auth.uid();·
      v_today       date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date;·
      v_is_live     boolean := (p_date = v_today);·
      v_mode        text := case when v_is_live then 'LIVE' else 'HISTORICAL' end;·
      v_is_admin    boolean := false;·

      select exists (·
        select 1 from public.profiles·
        where id = v_uid and role in ('SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'ADMIN')·
      ) into v_is_admin;···
      if not v_is_admin and not exists (·
        select 1 from public.user_permissions·
        where user_id = v_uid and permission = 'view_site_visit_observer' and revoked_at is null·
      ) then·
        return jsonb_build_object('error', 'PERMISSION_DENIED');·
      end if;···
      -- 2. Build Summary Counts·
      with visits_universe as (·
        select·
          fv.id as visit_id,·
          fv.user_id,·
          fv.status as visit_status,·
          svl.updated_at as last_ping_at·
        from public.field_visits fv·
        join public.profiles p on p.id = fv.user_id·
        left join public.site_visit_live_locations svl on svl.user_id = fv.user_id·
        where fv.date = p_date·
          and coalesce(fv.verification_status, 'PENDING') <> 'REJECTED'·
          and (p_employee_id is null or fv.user_id = p_employee_id)·
          and (p_visit_id is null or fv.id = p_visit_id)·
          and (v_is_admin or public.can_access_user_data(fv.user_id, 'view_site_visit_observer'))·
      ),·
      counts as (·
        select·
          count(*)::int as total_visits,·
          count(*) filter (where visit_status = 'IN_TRANSIT')::int as in_transit,·
          count(*) filter (where visit_status = 'CHECKED_IN')::int as at_site,·
          count(*) filter (where visit_status in ('COMPLETED', 'MISSED'))::int as completed,·
          count(distinct user_id) filter (·
            where v_is_live·
              and visit_status in ('IN_TRANSIT', 'CHECKED_IN')·
              and (last_ping_at is null or last_ping_at < now() - interval '5 minutes')·
          )::int as signal_lost·
        from visits_universe·
      )·
      select jsonb_build_object(·
        'total_visits', coalesce(c.total_visits, 0),·
        'in_transit',   coalesce(c.in_transit, 0),·
        'at_site',      coalesce(c.at_site, 0),·
        'completed',    coalesce(c.completed, 0),·
        'signal_lost',  coalesce(c.signal_lost, 0)·
      ) into v_summary·
      from counts c;···
      -- 3. Build Employee & Visit List·
      with relevant_visits as (·
        select·
          fv.id as visit_id,·
          fv.user_id,·
          fv.status as visit_status,·
          fv.location_name,·
          fv.project_name,·
          fv.checkin_time,·
          fv.checkout_time,·
          fv.visit_type,·
          (fv.destination_coords->>'latitude')::double precision as dest_lat,·
          (fv.destination_coords->>'longitude')::double precision as dest_lon,·
          coalesce(fv.client_name, fv.contact_name) as client_name,·
          coalesce(fv.client_phone, fv.contact_phone) as client_phone,·
          fv.created_at·
        from public.field_visits fv·
        where fv.date = p_date·
          and coalesce(fv.verification_status, 'PENDING') <> 'REJECTED'·
          and (p_employee_id is null or fv.user_id = p_employee_id)·
          and (p_visit_id is null or fv.id = p_visit_id)·
          and (v_is_admin or public.can_access_user_data(fv.user_id, 'view_site_visit_observer'))·
      ),·
      distinct_employees as (·
        select distinct user_id from relevant_visits·
      ),·
      employee_cards as (·
        select·
          p.id as employee_id,·
          p.name,·
          p.employee_number as employee_no,·
          p.role,·
          p.department,·
          off.name as office_name,·
          -- Tracking determination·
          case·
            when not v_is_live then 'COMPLETED'·
            when has_active.val and (svl.updated_at is null or svl.updated_at < now() - interval '5 minutes') then 'SIGNAL_LOST'·
            when svl.tracking_status = 'AT_SITE' then 'AT_SITE'·
            when svl.tracking_status = 'IN_TRANSIT' then 'IN_TRANSIT'·
            when has_active.val then 'IN_TRANSIT'·
            else 'COMPLETED'·
          end as computed_status,·
          case·
            when not v_is_live then 'COMPLETED'·
            when svl.updated_at is null or svl.updated_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' then 'SIGNAL_LOST'·
            when svl.updated_at < now() - interval '2 minutes' then 'DELAYED'·
            else 'LIVE'·
          end as computed_signal_status,·
          svl.latitude,·
          svl.longitude,·
          svl.accuracy_m,·
          svl.battery_level,·
          svl.speed_mps,·
          svl.updated_at as ping_updated_at,·
          -- Nested visits·
          (·
            select jsonb_agg(·
              jsonb_build_object(·
                'visit_id',        rv.visit_id,·
                'status',          rv.visit_status,·
                'location_name',   rv.location_name,·
                'project_name',    rv.project_name,·
                'checkin_time',    rv.checkin_time,·
                'checkout_time',   rv.checkout_time,·
                'visit_type',      rv.visit_type,·
                'destination_lat', rv.dest_lat,·
                'destination_lon', rv.dest_lon,·
                'client_name',     rv.client_name,·
                'client_phone',    rv.client_phone·
              ) order by rv.created_at asc·
            )·
            from relevant_visits rv·
            where rv.user_id = p.id·
          ) as visits_json·
        from distinct_employees de·
        join public.profiles p on p.id = de.user_id·
        left join public.offices off on off.id = p.office_id·
        left join public.site_visit_live_locations svl on svl.user_id = p.id and v_is_live·
        cross join lateral (·
          select exists (·
            select 1 from relevant_visits v·
            where v.user_id = p.id and v.visit_status in ('IN_TRANSIT', 'CHECKED_IN')·
          ) as val·
        ) has_active·
        order by p.name asc·
      )·
      select coalesce(·
        jsonb_agg(·
          jsonb_build_object(·
            'employee_id',     ec.employee_id,·
            'name',            ec.name,·
            'employee_no',     ec.employee_no,·
            'role',            ec.role,·
            'department',      ec.department,·
            'office_name',     ec.office_name,·
            'tracking', jsonb_build_object(·
              'status',        ec.computed_status,·
              'signal_status', ec.computed_signal_status,·
              'latitude',      ec.latitude,·
              'longitude',     ec.longitude,·
              'accuracy',      ec.accuracy_m,·
              'battery_level', ec.battery_level,·
              'speed_mps',     ec.speed_mps,·
              'updated_at',    ec.ping_updated_at·
            ),·
            'visits',          coalesce(ec.visits_json, '[]'::jsonb),·
            -- Compatibility aliases·
            'latest_lat',      ec.latitude,·
            'latest_lon',      ec.longitude,·
            'tracking_status', ec.computed_status,·
            'updated_at',      ec.ping_updated_at·
          )·
        ),·
        '[]'::jsonb·
      ) into v_employees·
      from employee_cards ec;···
      return jsonb_build_object(·
        'date',      p_date::text,·
        'mode',      v_mode,·
        'is_live',   v_is_live,·
        'summary',   coalesce(v_summary, '{\"total_visits\": 0, \"in_transit\": 0, \"at_site\": 0, \"completed\": 0, \"signal_lost\": 0}'::jsonb),·
        'employees', coalesce(v_employees, '[]'::jsonb)·
      );·
    end $$;···

    grant execute on function public.get_site_visit_observer_data(date, uuid, uuid) to authenticated;···

    -- Enhanced Site Visit Report Export with Scoped Access, 90-Day Range Limit, and Audit Logging···
    drop function if exists public.generate_site_visit_report(date, date);···
    create or replace function public.generate_site_visit_report(·
      p_start_date date,·
      p_end_date   date·
    )·
    returns table (·
      employee_name         text,·
      employee_no           text,·
      department            text,·
      branch                text,·
      visit_date            date,·
      day_of_week           text,·
      check_in_time         text,·
      check_out_time        text,·
      project_name          text,·
      client_name           text,·
      client_phone          text,·
      visit_type            text,·
      visit_status          text,·
      duration_minutes      int,·
      distance_travelled_km double precision,·
      tracking_status       text,·
      gps_point_count       int·
    )·
    language plpgsql·
    security definer·
    set search_path = public, pg_temp·
    as $$·
    declare·
      v_uid         uuid := auth.uid();·
      v_is_admin    boolean := false;·
      v_record_count int := 0;·
    begin·
      -- 1. Authentication·
      if v_uid is null then·
        raise exception 'AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED';·
      end if;···
      -- 2. Date-Range Limit (Maximum 90 days)·
      if p_start_date is null or p_end_date is null or p_end_date < p_start_date then·
        raise exception 'INVALID_DATE_RANGE';·
      end if;···
      if (p_end_date - p_start_date) > 90 then·
        raise exception 'Please select a maximum 90-day range.';·
      end if;···
      -- 3. Permission Gate·
      select exists (·
        select 1 from public.profiles·
        where id = v_uid and role in ('SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'ADMIN')·
      ) into v_is_admin;···
      if not v_is_admin and not exists (·
        select 1 from public.user_permissions·
        where user_id = v_uid and permission = 'view_location_reports' and revoked_at is null·
      ) then·
        raise exception 'PERMISSION_DENIED';·
      end if;···
      -- 4. Count for audit log·
      select count(*) into v_record_count·
      from public.field_visits fv·
      where fv.date between p_start_date and p_end_date·
        and (v_is_admin or public.can_access_user_data(fv.user_id, 'view_location_reports'));···
      -- 5. Audit Log Entry·
      perform public.log_audit_event(·
        'LOCATION_REPORT_EXPORTED',·
        'field_visits',·
        null,·
        null,·
        jsonb_build_object(·
          'start_date', p_start_date,·
          'end_date', p_end_date,·
          'records_count', v_record_count·
        )·
      );···
      -- 6. Query and Return Rows·
      return query·
      select·
        p.name as employee_name,·
        p.employee_number as employee_no,·
        p.department,·
        coalesce(off.name, 'Main Office') as branch,·
        fv.date as visit_date,·
        to_char(fv.date, 'FMDay') as day_of_week,·
        to_char(fv.checkin_time at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata', 'HH12:MI AM') as check_in_time,·
        to_char(fv.checkout_time at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata', 'HH12:MI AM') as check_out_time,·
        coalesce(fv.project_name, fv.location_name, 'Site') as project_name,·
        coalesce(fv.client_name, fv.contact_name) as client_name,·
        coalesce(fv.client_phone, fv.contact_phone) as client_phone,·
        fv.visit_type,·
        fv.status as visit_status,·
        case·
          when fv.checkout_time is not null and fv.checkin_time is not null·
          then (extract(epoch from (fv.checkout_time - fv.checkin_time))::int / 60)·
          else null·
        end as duration_minutes,·
        coalesce(round((fv.last_distance_m / 1000.0)::numeric, 2)::double precision, 0.0) as distance_travelled_km,·
        coalesce(svl.tracking_status, 'COMPLETED') as tracking_status,·
        coalesce(pts.cnt, 0)::int as gps_point_count·
      from public.field_visits fv·
      join public.profiles p on p.id = fv.user_id·
      left join public.offices off on off.id = p.office_id·
      left join public.site_visit_live_locations svl on svl.field_visit_id = fv.id·
      left join lateral (·
        select count(*)::int as cnt·
        from public.site_visit_location_history hist·
        where hist.field_visit_id = fv.id·
      ) pts on true·
      where fv.date between p_start_date and p_end_date·
        and (v_is_admin or public.can_access_user_data(fv.user_id, 'view_location_reports'))·
      order by fv.date desc, p.name asc, fv.created_at asc;·
    end $$;···
    revoke all on function public.generate_site_visit_report(date, date) from public, anon;·
    grant execute on function public.generate_site_visit_report(date, date) to authenticated;···

    create or replace function public.archive_exited_employee(·
      p_user_id        uuid,·
      p_lifecycle_step text,·
      p_exit_date      date default null,·
      p_reason         text default null·
    )·
    returns jsonb·
    language plpgsql·
    security definer·
    set search_path = public, pg_temp·

    declare·
      v_uid uuid := auth.uid();·

        select 1 from public.profiles·
        where id = v_uid and role in ('SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'HR', 'HRD')·

        lifecycle_status = v_step,·

        'EMPLOYEE_ARCHIVED',·
        'profiles',·
        p_user_id::text,·
        null,·
        jsonb_build_object('lifecycle_status', v_step, 'exit_date', p_exit_date, 'reason', p_reason)·
      );···
      return jsonb_build_object(·
        'success', true,·
        'user_id', p_user_id,·
        'lifecycle_status', v_step,·
        'exit_date', p_exit_date·
      );·
    end $$;···

    language plpgsql·
    stable·

      loader: () => Promise<{ default: T }>,·
      permission?: string | string[]·

      const Lazy = React.lazy(loader);·
      const DeferredScreen = function (props: React.ComponentProps<T>) {·

              <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: \"center\", justifyContent: \"center\" }}>·

              </View>·

          >·
            <Lazy {...props} />·
          </React.Suspense>·
        );·
      };·
      return permission ? withPermissionGuard(DeferredScreen, permission) : DeferredScreen;·

    // One request is capped by PostgREST \"max rows\" (Supabase default 1000), so a·
    // month for ~250 employees used to come back as only the newest ~4 days·
    // (the RPC orders work_date DESC). We fetch the range in small date windows and·
    // page inside each window until a short page arrives. PAGE_SIZE must stay at or·
    // below the project's max-rows setting.·
    const PAGE_SIZE = 500;·
    // One day per request. The server builds the WHOLE window for every page it·
    // returns (LIMIT/OFFSET are applied after the function), so a 3-day window·
    // that needed 2 pages was computed twice. One-day windows fit in one page.·
    const WINDOW_DAYS = 1;·
    const WINDOW_CONCURRENCY = 4;·
    // Same day requested by several screens / every live refresh: reuse it briefly.·
    const DAY_CACHE_MS = 30_000;·
    const dayCache = new Map<string, { at: number; rows: Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> }>();···
    class CanonicalRpcMissingError extends Error {}···
    function dateWindows(start: string, end: string): Array<[string, string]> {·
      // Newest window first, matching the RPC's work_date DESC order.·
      const windows: Array<[string, string]> = [];·
      let windowEnd = end;·
      while (windowEnd >= start) {·
        const candidate = addBusinessDays(windowEnd, -(WINDOW_DAYS - 1));·
        const windowStart = candidate < start ? start : candidate;·
        windows.push([windowStart, windowEnd]);·
        windowEnd = addBusinessDays(windowStart, -1);·
      }·
      return windows;·
    }···
    const istClock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(\"en-GB\", {·
      timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
      hour: \"2-digit\",·
      minute: \"2-digit\",·
      second: \"2-digit\",·
      hourCycle: \"h23\",·
    });···
    /**·
     * Late = first check-in (IST) at or after the office policy time·
     * (late_checkin_time from the server, 10:33:00 if no policy). The canonical·
     * RPC has no is_late column, so this is the single place it is derived.·
     */·
    export function isLateCheckin(firstIn: string | null | undefined, lateTime: string | null | undefined): boolean {·
      if (!firstIn) return false;·
      const instant = new Date(firstIn);·
      if (Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())) return false;·
      const threshold = String(lateTime || DEFAULT_LATE_CHECKIN_TIME);·
      const normalized = threshold.length === 5 ? `${threshold}:00` : threshold.slice(0, 8);·
      return istClock.format(instant) >= normalized;·
    }···
    export function mapRow(c: any): CanonicalAttendanceDay {·
      return {·
        ...c,·
        official_first_in: c.effective_checkin,·
        official_last_out: c.effective_checkout,·
        attendance_status: c.effective_status,·
        is_late: c.is_late ?? isLateCheckin(c.effective_checkin ?? c.official_first_in, c.late_checkin_time),·
        check_in_office_id: c.check_in_office_id ?? c.office_id,·
        check_in_office_name: c.check_in_office_name ?? c.office_name,·
        attendance_source:·
          c.attendance_source ?? (c.biometric_first_in ? \"BIOMETRIC\" : \"APP\"),·
        first_in_source:·
          c.app_first_in && c.biometric_first_in·
            ? \"COMBINED\"·
            : c.biometric_first_in·
              ? \"BIOMETRIC\"·
              : c.app_first_in·
                ? \"APP\"·
                : c.field_visit_first_in·
                  ? \"FIELD_VISIT\"·
                  : \"NONE\",·
      } as CanonicalAttendanceDay;·
    }···
    export const CanonicalAttendanceService = {·
      /**·
       * Fetch every row for the date range. Never returns a silently truncated·
       * result: throws if more than `maximum` rows would be loaded.·
       * Authorization is enforced by the RPC; scopeFilters can only narrow it.·
       */·
      async list(·
        start: string,·
        end: string,·
        maximum = 20_000,·
        scopeFilters?: any,·
      ): Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> {·
        if (end < start) return [];·
        const windows = dateWindows(start, end);·
        const results: CanonicalAttendanceDay[][] = new Array(windows.length);·
        let loaded = 0;···
        try {·
          for (let i = 0; i < windows.length; i += WINDOW_CONCURRENCY) {·
            const batch = windows.slice(i, i + WINDOW_CONCURRENCY);·
            const pages = await Promise.all(·
              batch.map(([ws, we]) => this._listWindow(ws, we, scopeFilters)),·
            );·
            pages.forEach((rows, j) => {·
              results[i + j] = rows;·
              loaded += rows.length;·
            });·
            if (loaded > maximum) {·
              throw new Error(·
                \"Range too large: narrow the date range or office filter to load attendance data.\",·
              );·
            }·
          }·
        } catch (error) {·
          if (error instanceof CanonicalRpcMissingError) {·
            return this._listFromView(start, end, maximum, scopeFilters);·
          }·
          throw error;·
        }···
        return results.flat();·
      },···
      /** One date window from the RPC, paged until a short page. */·
      async _listWindow(·
        start: string,·
        end: string,·
        scopeFilters?: any,·
      ): Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> {·
        const rows: CanonicalAttendanceDay[] = [];·
        for (let offset = 0; ; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {·
          const { data, error } = await supabase·
            .rpc(\"rpc_attendance_canonical_range\", {·
              p_start_date: start,·
              p_end_date: end,·
              p_office_id: scopeFilters?.office_id ?? null,·
              p_team_id: scopeFilters?.team_id ?? null,·
              p_user_id: scopeFilters?.user_id ?? null,·
            })·
            .range(offset, offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1);···
          if (error) {·
            if (error.code === \"PGRST202\" || error.code === \"42883\") {·
              throw new CanonicalRpcMissingError(error.message);·
            }·
            if (error.code === \"57014\" || error.message?.includes(\"timeout\")) {·
              throw new Error(·
                \"The date range is too large. Please select a shorter date range to prevent timeouts.\",·
              );·
            }·
            throw new Error(error.message);·
          }···
          const page = (data ?? []).map(mapRow);·
          rows.push(...page);·
          if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) return rows;·
        }·
      },···
      /** Fallback: paginate directly against the canonical view. */·
      async _listFromView(·
        start: string,·
        end: string,·
        maximum: number,·
        scopeFilters?: any,·
      ): Promise<CanonicalAttendanceDay[]> {·
        const rows: CanonicalAttendanceDay[] = [];·
        for (let offset = 0; offset <= maximum; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {·
          const { data, error } = await supabase·
            .from(\"v_attendance_daily_canonical\")·
            .select(\"*\")·
            .gte(\"work_date\", start)·
            .lte(\"work_date\", end)·
            .match(scopeFilters || {})·
            .order(\"work_date\", { ascending: false })·
            .order(\"employee_name\", { ascending: true })·
            .order(\"user_id\", { ascending: true })·
            .range(offset, offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1);···
          if (error) {·
            if (error.code === \"57014\" || error.message?.includes(\"timeout\")) {·
              throw new Error(·
                \"The date range is too large. Please select a shorter date range.\",·
              );·
            }·
            throw new Error(error.message);·
          }···
          const page = (data ?? []).map(mapRow);·
          rows.push(...page);·
          if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) return rows;·
        }·
        throw new Error(·
          \"Range too large: narrow the date range or office filter to load attendance data.\",·
        );·
      },···
      /**·
       * One business day. Calls made within 30 s of each other (Live Tracking·
       * refreshes, dashboards) share one server request instead of each running·
       * the expensive attendance calculation again.·
       */·
      async listDay(workDate: string, options?: { fresh?: boolean }) {·
        const cached = dayCache.get(workDate);·
        if (!options?.fresh && cached && Date.now() - cached.at < DAY_CACHE_MS) {·
          return cached.rows;·
        }·
        const rows = this.list(workDate, workDate, 5_000);·
        dayCache.set(workDate, { at: Date.now(), rows });·
        rows.catch(() => {·
          if (dayCache.get(workDate)?.rows === rows) dayCache.delete(workDate);·
        });·
        return rows;·
      },···
      /** Forget cached days (after an attendance correction or a manual refresh). */·
      invalidateDayCache() {·
        dayCache.clear();·
      },·
    };···
    /** Compatibility projection while older cards are migrated to v3 field names. */·
    export function withAttendanceV2Aliases(row: CanonicalAttendanceDay) {·

    }·

        if (status.includes(\"NO CHECKOUT\") || status.includes(\"P-NC\")) {·

        if (status.includes(\"CONFIG REQUIRED\")) {·

    function showAlert(title: string, message?: string) {·
      if (Platform.OS === \"web\") {·
        window.alert(message ? `${title}\\n\\n${message}` : title);·
      } else {·
        Alert.alert(title, message);·
      }·
    }···

    function formatUpdatedAge(loadedAt: number | null): string {·
      if (loadedAt == null) return \"Updating…\";·
      const minutes = Math.floor(Math.max(0, Date.now() - loadedAt) / 60_000);·
      if (minutes < 1) return \"Updated just now\";·
      if (minutes <= 60) return `Updated ${minutes} min ago`;·
      return `Updated at ${new Date(loadedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {·
        hour: \"2-digit\",·
        minute: \"2-digit\",·
        timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
      })}`;·
    }·

    // ─── StatCard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────·
    function StatCard({·
      icon,·
      title,·
      value,·
      subtitle,·
      color,·
      valueColor,·
      onPress,·
    }: {·
      icon: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;·
      title: string;·
      value: string | number;·
      subtitle?: string;·
      color: string;·
      valueColor?: string;·
      onPress?: () => void;·
    }) {·
      const { theme, isDark } = useTheme();·
      return (·
        <Pressable·
          style={({ pressed }) => [·
            styles.statCard,·
            {·
              borderLeftColor: color,·
              backgroundColor: theme.backgroundDefault,·
              opacity: pressed ? 0.88 : 1,·
            },·
            {·
              borderLeftColor: color,·
              backgroundColor: isDark·
                ? \"rgba(255,255,255,0.06)\"·
                : theme.backgroundDefault,·
              opacity: pressed ? 0.88 : 1,·
            },·
            isWeb && styles.statCardWeb,·
          ]}·
          onPress={onPress}·
        >·
          <View style={[styles.statIcon, { backgroundColor: color + \"18\" }]}>·
            <Feather name={icon} size={18} color={color} />·
          </View>·
          <ThemedText·
            type=\"caption\"·
            style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, marginBottom: 2, fontSize: 11 }}·
          >·
            {title}·
          </ThemedText>·
          <ThemedText·
            style={{·
              color: valueColor ?? theme.text,·
              fontWeight: \"800\",·
              fontSize: 20,·
              lineHeight: 26,·
            }}·
          >·
            {value}·
          </ThemedText>·
          {subtitle ? (·
            <ThemedText·
              type=\"caption\"·
              style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, fontSize: 10, marginTop: 1 }}·
            >·
              {subtitle}·
            </ThemedText>·
          ) : null}·
        </Pressable>·
      );·
    }···

      const recordFraudEvidence = async (·

      const handleUndoCheckout = async () => {·

          });·

      const handleCheckOut = async () => {·

            );·

          setShowAttendanceCheckout(true);·
        } catch (err: any) {·

            serverCheckedIn: isCheckedIn,·
            serverCheckedOut: isCheckedIn && isCheckedOut,·

          });·
          if (done === \"CHECKOUT\") setOfflineCheckOutPending(true);·
        } finally {·

        }·
      };···
      const handleAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        // Set before any await so a double tap cannot start two check-ins.·
        if (attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current) return;·
        attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = true;·
        try {·
          await runAttendanceToggle();·
        } finally {·
          attendanceToggleInFlightRef.current = false;·
        }·
      };···
      const runAttendanceToggle = async () => {·
        if (!user?.id) {·
          showAlert(\"Error\", \"You must be logged in.\");·
          return;·
        }·
        if (!(await attendanceInternetAvailable())) {·
          await runOfflineAttendance();·

        }···

            \"You have already checked in and out for today.\",·
          );·

        }···
        if (isCheckedIn) {·
          await handleCheckOut();·
          return;·

      // A biometric punch is imported by the server even when this app is already·

      const recordFraudEvidence = async (·

      const handleUndoCheckout = async () => {·

      const runAttendanceToggle = async () => {·

      };···
      const handleEventAttendance = async (event: EventAttendanceAction) => {·
        if (!user?.id) return;·

      if (minutes <= 60) return `Updated ${minutes} min ago`;·
      return `Updated at ${new Date(loadedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {·
        hour: \"2-digit\",·
        minute: \"2-digit\",·
        timeZone: \"Asia/Kolkata\",·
      })}`;·
    }·
